column1: # Terms added by hand, on top of the labels and structures from ExpoPortal.
# annotate_jats.py reads this file; the cache is not changed.
#   label     its label; highlighted in the articles
#   synonyms  other names to highlight, separated by |
#   smiles    structure shown in the popup (used instead of the one in the cache)
#   inchikey  optional: a name that OPSIN turns into this structure is highlighted too
#   see_also  optional: where the SMILES comes from
# The SMILES of 6PPD and 6PPD-Q are the canonical SMILES from Wikidata (P233);
# the stereocentre next to the nitrogen is not specified.
